problem: Overlapping delivery candidates could enter expensive CI concurrently, creating queueing, main drift and repeated recovery work.
decision: Set max executable overlapping candidates to one while preserving parallelism for unrelated conflict contracts.
expected_effect: one conflicting candidate in expensive CI at a time
root_cause: The admission WIP budget allowed up to three executable candidates that shared the same conflict contracts, so multiple recovery and website candidates could simultaneously enter expensive CI and repeatedly invalidate each other as main advanced.
prevention_rule: For candidates that overlap on explicit delivery conflict contracts, admit only one executable candidate into expensive CI at a time; unrelated candidates may continue in parallel.
